description: This file defines a PHP controller class `ViewMyAttendanceController` within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. The class extends an abstract controller and manages the pre-render logic for the 'view-my-attendance' Vue component, setting properties based on the HTTP request and attendance configuration.

classes.name: ViewMyAttendanceController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing the Vue component for viewing personal attendance, including setting 'date' and 'is-editable' properties based on request data and user permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component prior to rendering, adding properties based on request parameters and user permissions.
